featurebullets: About this item 6 Preset Menus: Equipped with one-touch programs for popcorn, potato, pizza, frozen vegetables, beverages and dinner plate reheat, this countertop microwave oven simplifies your meal prep. Modern Black Finish: The sleek exterior design complements contemporary kitchen décor while the fingerprint-resistant surface maintains a clean appearance, suitable for apartments, condos, and modern homes. Express Cooking Feature: Start heating instantly with shortcut buttons, combined with 700 watts and 10 cooking power levels for fast reheating, reducing wait time for hot meals during lunch breaks or late-night snacks. Multi-Stage Cooking Function: Program sequential cooking steps automatically like switching from defrost to reheat, perfect for preparing frozen meals without manual intervention or constant monitoring. Compact 0.7 Cu Ft Capacity: Measuring 17.1 x 12.3 x 9.5 inches (LxWxH), this space-saving small microwave fits apartments, dorms, small kitchen spaces, and offices while still accommodating standard dinner plates for your everyday reheating needs. › See more product details
